subject: ENGLISH
title: Maxine’s Little Diary
objective: Recognize useful features of a simple diary entry.
introduction: A model diary entry may include a date, an event, and the writer’s thoughts or feelings. Explore examples, sort cards, practice, and answer five questions.

vocabulary.definition: A little book where you write about your day.
To put words and letters on paper.
A tale with characters and events.

activities.instruction: Study the idea and listen to the narration.
